semantic_contract: all policies: text, rejection, full ordered masks/roles/output, chosen route

method.pixel_transform: Bilinear inverse sampling at pixel centers; float64 coordinates and float32 interpolation; outside=source RGBmean
method.matching: Actual NMS proposals only; both zoom proposal and projected original box complete within frozen edgeMargin; one-to-one greedy IoU>=.5
method.dot_combination: Original and matched zoom dots: logit mean then probability mean; unmatched original dots stay unchanged
method.routing: First accepted text in fixed order; original geometry, scores and quality check unchanged; no GT access
method.actual_selected_zoom_execution: Only if the selected policy still rejects after its identity/flip prefix

qualification.reviewer: independent evaluation_audit agent; parent-approved pre-TEST empirical qualification
qualification.mathematical_certificate: All recorded absolute errors are <= the complete-domain maximum <= 0.0003; rtol=0.
rationale: All 205286400 finite raw scalar outputs were compared by the hash-bound original exporter.
All 2700 policy decisions preserve text, rejection, ordered semantic and physical masks, roles, outputs, and selected route.
The original 1e-4 absolute plus 1e-4 relative gate failed; this separate gate is reviewed before any fresh TEST exposure.
Final primary accuracy will use this unchanged actual TFLite artifact; no detector confidence, geometry, or parser threshold is relaxed.
limitations: This is an empirical validation qualification, not bitwise equality or a universal float32 error bound.
An unseen value arbitrarily close to a decision threshold may still change discrete behavior; strict backend TEST confirmation remains separate.
